title: Local finite constant extension towers
statement: Let C be a small site with final object X [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], B a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and K in the derived category of B-module-valued sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let a≤b be integers such that H^q(K) is zero outside [a,b], and every H^q(K) is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There is a covering {U_i to X} such that K restricted to C/U_i [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] has a finite constant extension tower T(constantSheaf on C/U_i,a,(b-a).toNat,K|U_i) [def-weil-pbc-finite-constant-extension-tower]. The output is a finite sequence of distinguished triangles, not a representing complex or chain maps for its boundary morphisms.

proof.text: Prove the width-zero case: concentration identifies K with a single cohomology object; a local finite trivialization identifies this object with a constant finite module. The private tower_single proof uses the canonical derived t-structure and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso.

source.place: Tag 094G, proof of lemma-locally-constant, triangles in the induction before chain realization

proof.text: Induct on n simultaneously for every object U and every K on C/U. For n+1 apply the nonrecursive local cone reduction to obtain a cover V_i to U, cones L_i with cohomology in [a,a+n], and rotated triangles with finite constant attachment in degree a+n. Apply the induction hypothesis to each L_i.

source.place: Tag 094G, proof of lemma-locally-constant, triangles in the induction before chain realization

proof.text: Restrict each rotated triangle to the refinement supplied by induction. Exact derived restriction is triangulated and carries a constant single object to the same constant single object on the smaller slice. The private restrict_step proof transports the triangle along this comparison and applies the tower step constructor. Derived composition and tower_of_iso identify the iterated restriction with restriction along the composite. Compose covers using Precoverage.comp_mem_coverings.

source.place: Tag 094G, proof of lemma-locally-constant, triangles in the induction before chain realization

proof.text: Start with restriction of the given global K to C/X. The exact derived homology comparison transports its vanishing bounds, and pushforwardOverMapIso transports the supplied local trivializations to every map V to X. The induction returns a covering of X. The canonical derived restriction/relocalization isomorphism identifies its resulting towers with the exact restriction objects in the unchanged conclusion; a+(b-a).toNat=b follows from a≤b.

theorem exists_site_finite_constant_extension_tower
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition]
    [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    (X : C) (hX : IsTerminal X)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (ModuleCat.{u} B))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (ModuleCat.{u} B)))
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hvan : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (ModuleCat.{u} B)) q).obj K))
    (hloc : ∀ (q : ℤ) (V : C),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C) (f : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ V),
        Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ J V ∧
        ∀ i : I, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} B, Module.Finite B M ∧ Nonempty
          ((J.toGrothendieck.overPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) (U i)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (ModuleCat.{u} B)) q).obj K) ≅
            (constantSheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (U i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C) (f : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ J X ∧
      ∀ i : I, FiniteConstantExtensionTower
        (constantSheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (U i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)) a
        (b - a).toNat
        ((@Functor.mapDerivedCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
            (J.toGrothendieck.overPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) (U i))
            (Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _) _
            ⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ PreservesColimitsOfSize.preservesColimitsOfShape
              (self := Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
                (Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous
                  (Over.forget (U i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)
                  (J.toGrothendieck.over (U i)) J.toGrothendieck))⟩).obj K)
